text.p: These are the leading stories in the Mozambican press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The meteorological institute says tropical depression Gretelle is dissipating and presents no further danger to southern Mozambique.

- Three armed robbers and a policeman were killed on Wednesday in a shootout in the southern Mozambican city of Xai- Xai. One of the gunmen, Nicolau "Nequinha" Cuinica, escaped from jail last December and police say he then went on a rampage of armed robberies.
